dependencyFindings.detail: Telemetry dependency graph is present and reused.
Analytics ingest contract is present and reused.

behaviorSurfaceFindings.detail: Required behavioral surfaces are represented in the tracking surface map.
Tracking surface map validates against anonymous ingest event types.

toggleFindings.detail: Policy distinguishes disabled tracking from consent denied.
Disabled behavior analytics suppress page, hover, scroll, visibility, click, creator interaction, drop, and watch-time behavior events.
Enabled behavior remains bounded and diagnostics are sampled.
Identified telemetry and GA companion dispatch consult the same client tracking policy.

ingestAlignmentFindings.detail: DeepTracker anonymous event types match the ingest contract and tracking surface map.

watchTimeFindings.detail: Runtime watch-time uses runtime media/session events and is not computed from page view or visibility alone.

staleBehaviorFindings.detail: No hardcoded behavior score shortcuts are reachable in the behavioral tracking closure files.

fixesApplied.detail: Added canonical client tracking policy with event kind decisions.
Refined the tracking surface map with persistence, aggregation, UI, admin, identity, and disabled behavior semantics.
Wired DeepTracker to the client tracking policy before queueing anonymous behavior events.
Wired trackEvent to the client tracking policy for identified and external companion dispatch.
Added the behavioral tracking semantics validator and generated truth artifact lane.
Added unit tests for tracking toggle and surface semantics.

prCleanupActions: No open behavioral tracking/toggle/analytics PRs were present at start.
nextFixOrder: When adding new behavior events, add them to the tracking surface map and ingest contract before emitting them from a client component.
Keep runtime watch-time sourced from media/session events only; do not derive it from page duration, page views, or visibility summaries.
Keep disabled behavior analytics quiet while preserving required account, security, and product integrity events through the policy.
